Episode 215. Reunion with the God (1)
December 12, 1803.
Following the return of the five members of the Black Sea expedition and Luntia, there was a steady increase in the number of returnees in Runcandel.
Among the returnees were even two people capable of handling the 'Great Fissures', like the one that occurred in Xiatelo last time - Luna's red sword energy and Luntia's Brother Stars.

After Xiatelo, they had each handled a Great Fissure that occurred in Huphyster and the Empire. Not only them, but also Jin and other knights, as well as the families' knights, were continually being dispatched to the areas where the fissures occurred.
Day after day, articles announcing the exploits of Runcandel poured out.
The ranking war had ended, and now the current generation of Runcandel members was finally joining forces to prepare for the upcoming future.
"The number of times Luntia's Brother Stars can be used is probably limited, just like father said. It means that it can't be used indefinitely until we ascend."
"Yes, Sister Luna. Unlike us, the youngest can use Eternalization without significant restrictions as long as she endures injuries, but the rate at which the fissures are occurring is unusual."
In the meeting room of the Garden of Swords, the knights and leaders were brainstorming. The map laid out on the table had over a hundred marked locations of the fissures.
"[Neither the Small Master nor the 1st and 3rd Knights can remove all of these fissures. In the end, we can only defend the main bases until the transition to Jinmakai ends.]"
Everyone in the meeting room nodded at Lueth's words.
"[At least the fortunate thing is that we are the most effective among the large forces in handling the fissures. It seems that Kinzelo and Zipeul are struggling quite a bit.]"
Kinzelo was dealing with the fissures slowly due to Orgal's injury, and Zipeul due to the war with the Enemy tribe.

It was a natural occurrence given the fewer number of people capable of removing the fissures compared to Runcandel. Already, rumors were circulating among the saints that Huphyster was the safest land.
Even though Jinmakai, a ticking bomb that could explode at any time, was still threatening the world.
Jin wasn't suffocated by a frustrating mind like before. He could solve it somehow with his brothers, comrades, family, and members of the coalition. Just like always.
Current Runcandel was strong.
It was undoubtedly the strongest it had been since the Temar generation, given that Chiron was always absent.

"The key issue is what happens after the transition. According to Ayula's revelation, it shouldn't be too far off. I also have a feeling it might coincide with the end of the Holy Kingdom's prayer and Ayula's manifestation. The Holy King also expects the same."
"That's right, youngest. No... Hmm-hmm! Yes, Small Master."
Luna quickly corrected her answer, avoiding Lueth's gaze as he gently rebuked her. Luna and Luntia were, after all, in the same situation as Ballas, being mindful of Lueth's mood.

"The Holy King sees the manifestation of Ayula on the last day of this year, or dawn on the first day of the new year. If the cracks continue to form at the current rate, we should be able to protect all major points by then."
They couldn't help but give up some areas, but no matter which strong forces emerged from the Demon World after the transition,
Runcandel was confident of fighting and winning.

"Surely there won't be hundreds or thousands of demons like Phaelito Belkasium, who smashed Orgal. I can't imagine our strongest knights losing to him or other demons... the variable would probably be Zito. But Zito is regaining his strength now, so he won't appear on the front lines at the start of the war."
"You're right, Sister Mary, if there were more than hundreds of such creatures, the ancient royal families wouldn't have held power in those days."

"But what bothers me a little is that while the Red and Blue clans, the ancient royal families, were sealed when Amelis slept, those creatures have never lost their history. Their technology would be at least on par with the Red Clan, and their army... Judging from the number of cracks, it will be enormous."

"Even if we assume that we have the upper hand in terms of the skills or number of top-tier fighters, if their troops and resources are overwhelming... Even if we win the war, the earth will suffer irreparable damage."
The purpose of the Demon World is to turn the earth into hell through suffering.
From the viewpoint of Runcandel, they were completely different types of madmen compared to Zipfel, Kinzelo, and the Red Clan.

Zipfel aims to conquer the world with as little damage as possible, Kinzelo aims to realize their own utopia through the resurrection of the Sun God, and the Red Clan also has the same goal of the resurrection of the Sun God, just in a different direction.

That's why they avoid indiscriminate slaughter. Of course, the Red Clan treats human life as food and treats humans like bugs, but for now, they are absolutely avoiding civilian casualties out of fear of Jin.
But the demons of the Demon World are not like that.
They will enjoy indiscriminate mass murder without any reason, and it would be commonplace for them to capture innocent people and torture them.
Therefore, this time again, the Runcandel and Vamel alliance had to fight a 'defensive' battle.
But it was impossible to protect everyone and fight with only the top superhumans including Jin and some special strong characters.
"We need a powerful weapons system and defense power that can wipe out the demons as they appear... usable even by those who are not special strong characters."

The members nodded at the words Jin spat out after organizing his thoughts. That was the most urgent element for Runcandel and the Vamel Alliance right now. There are quite a number of superhumans who can take on captain-level demons like Phaelito.
The Golden Fleet and the mass-produced Eiello.

"If we can complete those two things, our deficient 'general firepower' will greatly increase. The magic knight brigade of Runcandel, using storage paper, is becoming good enough to be deployed into real combat situations.

'Zipfel is already mass-producing bio-golems of magicians, and their fleet size is also growing, so they must have fewer concerns than we do. They also have the variable of the Devil's Stone. Kinzelo also has a fleet and unlike us, they don't have as many people to protect. After all, the populations of werewolves and demons are not large, and many of them are combat werewolves, and they also have a fleet.'
Runcandel also had variables equivalent to the 'perfect Orgal' or Devil's Stone.
The return of Chiron and the remaining expeditionary force.
However, Jin planned to wage war against the Demon World this time as well, excluding Chiron.
'My father is overcoming his own fate. And the fact that my father entrusted people to me means that he trusts me. This time, too, I can protect the family and the world.'
Of course, the thought that Chiron, who had overcome Devilization, would definitely return someday was a great comfort.
"Huh?"
While Jin was thinking, suddenly Yona (it was Yona's first time attending a formal family meeting, and even Lueth did not point out her informal address or honorifics) made a noise.
"Miss Yona, why is that?"
"Hee, the youngest, you were thinking about the Golden Fleet and the mass-produced Eelro, right?"
"Yes."

[Oh, my Yona. This cute thing! Your great-grandfather has been waiting for you to open your mouth! Ick... Sorry, butler. My great-granddaughter is so pretty. Yes, Yona. What do you want to talk about?]
"We've never thought that something like an underground world exists, have we?"
[Yes, yes. Who would have thought that such a thing existed? Tsk, the world has become strange.]
"Hee hee, but I just thought of the Phoenix, great-grandfather."
[Phoenix?]
"Do you mean the Phoenix, miss?"

"Yes, Phoenix. Phoenixes live in the flame world. But we don't know where the flame world is, and even Murakan, who says he went there, doesn't know how to go back. Hee, is it because he's stupid? Anyway, what I want to say is this. If the underworld can come up to the surface like this, couldn't the flame world do the same?"
Jin felt like he'd been hit on the back of the head with a blunt object. It was something he hadn't thought of at all.

"Huh... That's a good assumption, miss. If we can get help from the main body of Tess in the Flame World and the Phoenixes, no matter how great the demon's forces are, we can minimize the damage to the surface."

-"The name 'Flame World' is just a term we created in our dimension for convenience. It's a dimension where there's nothing but fire and phoenixes. Even the highest gods don't know what the real name of that world is.
-The gods don't know? Does that mean the Flame World is outside the jurisdiction of the gods?

-Ding dong, correct. Even the god of fire, Sheenu, can't control the fire of the Flame World at will. On the other hand, Tess, the master of the Flame World, also can't control Sheenu's fire as he pleases.
The conversation I had with Murakan the day I first summoned Tess.

Of course, borrowing the power of the Flame World is just wishful thinking. From the start, there was some kind of restriction between the human world and the Flame World, which is why Tess couldn't fully exert his power so far.

But now that the world is 'changing' with the collapse of the magical barrier, I thought there might be a way to remove that restriction. Perhaps the location of the Flame World is also somewhere underground.

'Murakan said he saw Tess extinguish middle-ranked gods just by breathing in the Flame World. It's probably impossible to fully draw on that power... but somehow, I have a good feeling. There seems to be a way. The world is changing.'
Jin imagined for a moment the phoenixes of the Flame World burning the invading demons on the surface and Tess overwhelming Zito. Even the imagination was quite sweet.
"Hee, I did well, right?"
"Yes, you did well, Miss. We should find out right away. First of all, when Murakan comes later, it would be best to summon Tess and have a conversation."
[This great-grandfather always thought Yona was the best!]
[Mr. Chairman of the Black Sword, we are in a meeting now... Ah, don't discriminate against your great-grandchildren. I do cherish Miss Yona very much, but others might feel left out.]
Despite saying that, Lueth knew everyone was pleased, not hurt.
[That Yona kid (at this point, Lueth finally broke the pen he was holding), hmm! The lord sent Yona too early to the underworld. So I have to give her more love now, hehe. Isn't that right?]
"I also like my great-grandfather, not as much as the youngest."
[But you like your great-grandfather more than the butler, right?]
"Hee, I'm not sure... If my great-grandfather plays ear-cutting game with me later, it might."
[Hahaha, this old man has already died once, so I don't mind losing an ear or two. As long as our Yona is having fun. Let's do it!]
While Yona and Ballas were giggling, the communication device rang out in resonance.
{My lord!}
It was a call from Tikan.
"Jet, what's going on?"
{Yulian's guardian dragon, Kaltor, has finally fully awakened! Miss Valleia says we should hurry and meet this guy named Peitel or something.}
